title: Nourishing Mild Saudi Arabian Penne Pasta
description: A comforting and cultured dish featuring penne pasta, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a sick day, with a brine-wet and fluffy texture that is sure to soothe, inspired by the rich flavors of Saudi Arabian cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the saucepan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth, canned diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes.
Drain the cooked penne pasta and add it to the saucepan, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
